terra.problem: “Without ending” is confusing alongside “until the Messiah comes.” Calvin describes Judah’s rule continuing until the Messiah, while Jamieson-Fausset-Brown says Judah would no longer have its own king or judge after He came. The notes also differ on “between his feet”: Calvin describes a lawgiver at the king’s feet, while Clarke understands it as referring to Judah’s offspring. Explain these differences simply. “Lawgiver” may also need explaining for a 10-year-old.
